name_input: LNSK GREEN HOUSE AGRO PRODUCTS LLP
product_summary: Frozen warmwater shrimp (penaeid shrimp, farmed), exported to the USA. Corroborated only indirectly: SeafoodSource (07.03.2023) reports that in the US DOC 16th administrative review of the antidumping duty order on frozen warmwater shrimp from India, the margin for LNSK Green House Agro Products LLP was kept unchanged at zero percent — i.e. the company is a named respondent/exporter in the US frozen warmwater shrimp AD case. ImportGenius lists the company as a supplier with US customs records including shipments to Pacific Seafood Clackamas (Clackamas, Oregon) — page itself was JS-blocked, so the shipment detail is taken from the search snippet only, not read directly. No company website, catalogue or IndiaMART page could be opened (lnskgreenhouse.com does not resolve; indiamart path 404). Product range beyond frozen shrimp (e.g. other frozen fish, value-added/PDTO/IQF shrimp, dried fish) is NOT corroborated anywhere — заявлено, не подтверждено.
comment: HS 030617 (frozen shrimps and prawns) matches the only verifiable product line — frozen warmwater shrimp — so the declared code is correct: match_status = exact, no correction needed. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a broad retail/FMCG label and is a misclassification of the actual activity: this is a seafood processor/exporter (frozen crustaceans, B2B bulk export), not an FMCG food-products company; the correct industry framing is 'морепродукты / переработка и экспорт креветки'. Trader signs: the company appears in US AD proceedings as an exporter and in US import records as a supplier to a US importer (Pacific Seafood) — this is consistent with an exporter/trader-processor role, but whether it owns processing capacity or buys from third-party plants is not public; role left as unknown rather than asserted. Product lines missing from the declaration: none can be identified from public sources, but absence of a website/catalogue means the declared single HS line cannot be treated as exhaustive — any additional lines (other frozen fish 0303/0304, value-added shrimp preparations 1605) are заявлено, не подтверждено. Per project rules the company is kept; no rejection on HS grounds. Sources: https://www.seafoodsource.com/news/premium/supply-trade/us-to-raise-antidumping-duty-on-indian-shrimp-exporters (read); https://www.importgenius.com/suppliers/lnsk-green-house-agro-products-llp (snippet only, page blocked). No registry, revenue or customs-volume research performed per role scope.
